entities.summary: Adergoudounbadēs was a prominent Sasanian nobleman, general, and kanarang during the reigns of Kavadh I and Khosrow I. His life is known only through the work of the Byzantine historian Procopius. His native name was probably Adurgundbad, an abbreviation of Adurgushnaspbad. Pourshariati records the native name as Ādhargulbād (آذرگلباد).
